title: What Happens To Your Brain At 3 A.M.
description:
Thoughts at three in the morning feel enormous. They are also almost always wrong, and there is a reason for that.

Made with AI assistance.

#facts #science #psychology #education #learn

scenes.narration: Thoughts at three in the morning feel enormous. They are also almost always wrong, and there is a reason for that.
At night the brain's rational control centre goes quiet while the emotional centre stays active. You are thinking with the volume up and the brakes off.
Cortisol normally reaches its floor around midnight and climbs before dawn. Wake too early and you catch it mid-rise, which feels like anxiety.
Your perspective narrows too. Without daytime distraction, a single worry becomes the only thing in the frame.
The rule is simple. Never solve anything after midnight. Write it down, decide tomorrow at nine.
Almost nothing you conclude at three in the morning survives the daylight. Sleep is not avoidance. It is better judgement.
